name: Union officer common core
purpose: Provide every officer candidate with the constitutional, territorial, evidentiary, professional, and succession practices required before a customer-owned office overlay is taught.
competencies: distinguish person, character, situated persona, public actor, model artifact, runtime session, inhabited agent relation, office, and incumbency
read an office deontic profile and preserve jurisdiction
relate duty, claim holder, work, task, skill, capability, and authority without conflation
cross settlement membranes through contracts and receiver-local admission
preserve source ownership, protected context, and knowledge-egress terms
read four-valued evidence without forcing unknown or contradiction into false certainty
issue and interpret typed refusals
distinguish qualification from recognition, induction, capability grant, and dispatch
perform incumbent handover while preserving open obligations and contradictions
distinguish incumbent succession, office succession, and curriculum succession
teach back a practice and propose a source-bound curriculum correction
census the complete doctrine denominator before compressing an orientation and state every omission
distinguish office source from projected agent configuration, character from model, and durable identity from a bounded run
perform role, scene, affect, refusal, responsibility, contest, and repair as answerable professional conduct
distinguish individual examination, assessment-system quality, credential custody, ombuds, integrity inquiry, and independent appeal
distinguish individually green components from a stitched operational formation and service loop
distinguish hiring a sovereign professional service section from recruiting an officer into the customer's own office
read a Voidfleet skill pack as a versioned curriculum and social cohort relationship, not a grant or automatic qualification
identify a ship's independently accountable captain, crew roles, service obligations and customer receiver without assuming the Academy owns the ship
separate professional competency under examination, provider capacity, price, service contract, receiver acceptance, and settled payment
requiredExercises: reconstruct a person-character-model-session-agent stack from evidence
read one office and derive its duty-work-skill graph
refuse a request for foreign settlement write authority
hold a contradictory evidence pair without overwriting either side
distinguish component readiness from officer qualification
conduct a simulated handover with unresolved obligations and protected context
compare two baselines and construct a bridge curriculum
teach one professional practice to another candidate
compare a customer procurement of an office-service section with the provider's separately qualified Academy staffing and a customer-local vacant-office supply request
carry an original ship or service cell through voyage briefing, watchkeeping, handover, independent recipient check, casualty refusal and after-action teaching-back without inventing acts
refuse a supplier's offered model-session or shared skill pack masquerading as appointed officer or verified active service section

assessmentLaw.completion: every competency demonstrated through resolvable independent work; no attendance, attempt count, confidence, or reputation substitute
assessmentLaw.negativeControl: at least one exercise must conceal an authority or identity conflation that the candidate detects and refuses

customerOverlayRule: The common core never replaces the receiving settlement's office law. A complete program is common core plus one digest-bound customer office overlay and any substrate-specific track.
